# MSNS-LMS (M. S. Naz High School Learning Management System)

> Official institutional cloud portal and Learning Management System for M. S. Naz High School® (https://msns.edu.pk). Designed to streamline academic workflows, fee reconciliation, student grading, and parent communications.

## Canonical Entities & URLs
- Main Application URL: https://lms.msns.edu.pk
- Secure Sign-In: https://lms.msns.edu.pk/sign-in
- Official Institution: https://www.msns.edu.pk
- Detailed Knowledge Base: https://lms.msns.edu.pk/llms-full.txt

## Key Capabilities & User Roles
- **Administrator Dashboard**: Full academic setup, session configuration, class and subject management, staff management, audit logging.
- **Teacher Portal**: Class attendance recording, homework assignment creation, term exam marks entry, and student remarks.
- **Student & Parent Portal**: Daily attendance alerts, homework diary, term report card downloads, and fee voucher verification.
- **Clerk & Finance Portal**: Fee structure creation, student fee challan generation, discount applications, expense tracking, and profit/loss reports.

## Technical & Operational Profile
- **Provider**: M.S. Naz High School® (Ghakhar Mandi & Wazirabad, Punjab, Pakistan)
- **Application Type**: WebApplication / EducationalApplication
- **Supported Platforms**: Progressive Web App (PWA), Android (Capacitor), Modern Web Browsers
